component.name: darktable
component.summary: Organize and develop images from digital cameras (with AI subsystem enabled)

description.p: darktable manages your camera raw files and images in a database, lets you view them through lighttable mode and develop/enhance them in darkroom mode.
This Flatpak build includes the ONNX Runtime and compiles darktable with the optional AI subsystem enabled (-DUSE_AI=ON) for AI masking, denoising, and upscaling.
